Profile Edaravone is a free-radical scavenger used in the management of acute ischaemic stroke (p.1185). It is given by intravenous infu- sion in a dose of 30 mg twice daily, infused over 30 minutes, be- ginning within 24 hours of stroke onset and continued for up to 14 days. ◊ References. 1.
